chunk_map.heading: Every task maps onto the same six phases

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1's 'them'/'across them' resolves to 'six phases' stated one clause earlier; the six bold-led bullets each define their own term inline (Intent./Context./Work./Verification./Absorption./Outcome.). Chunk 2's 'this territory' resolves against chunk 0's title 'The whole map' plus chunk 1's 'cycle'/'six phases'; 'the near half'/'the far half' resolve against the phase names chunk 1 already bulleted. No forward references, no orphaned pronouns.
No pointer to another file, by position or otherwise, occurs anywhere in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'M1 was the first step into this territory' names the real, current preceding module (M1) rather than a specific exercise/lecture beat; no dead beat reference is present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal demo instruction occurs in this container lecture.
Chunk 1 carries the full figure, six defined phases, and the places-not-pipeline claim; chunk 2 carries three self-carrying orientation bullets. Neither is a bare wait-state.

'Every task maps onto the same six phases' is confirmed by the body's 'Every piece of agentic work maps onto the same cycle. Six phases' — the softened 'maps onto' wording (fresh 2026-08-18 edit) matches between header and body, so header truth holds under the mapping-not-identity framing. 'You are here' is confirmed by the chunk's orientation content (M1 recap, near/far half split).

No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative; no number-with-retraction; no abstraction-noun stack. The SVG's short verb chains ('act · read the result · correct'; 'run · let it fail · shape the verifier · re-run'; 'read · judge · gate what ships · by hand for now') are each concrete on every leg, not empty-leg triplets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/authorial dialect term (surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, Connections) appears in body or SVG label text.
